JUDGMENT IN FAVOR OF PLAINTIFF HORNSTEIN LAW OFFICES, PROFESSIONAL CORPORATION, AND AGAINST DEFENDANTS YAN JUAN LUO, D&L ELITE INVESTMENTS, BILL DENG AND WEISHEN LUO IN THE AMOUNT OF TWENTY-FIVE THOUSAND ($25,000.00) DOLLARS. THE COURT DENIES PLAINTIFF'S REQUEST FOR SANCTIONS AGAINST MS. LUO. SETTLEMENT REACHED EARLIER THIS AFTERNOON BETWEEN PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT KEVIN NGUYEN, WHEREIN CASE AGAINST MR. NGUYEN IS DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE, WITH EACH SIDE TO BEAR THEIR OWN ATTORNEY FEES AND COSTS. COUNSEL FOR PLAINTIFF SHALL PREPARE A PROPOSED FORM JUDGMENT AND SUBMIT SAME TO THE COURT FOR REVIEW AND SIGNATURE. PROCEEDINGS NOT REPORTED. JUDGE: LESLIE C. NICHOLS. CLERK: K. DOUGHERTY. (D220).
